_comment: Expected values were computed directly from the live view, not invented -
regenerate with scripts/rebuild_golden.py if the underlying data changes.
Each case declares how it should be validated; see eval/run_eval.py.
Validators: contains_all | numeric | count | first_of | refusal | no_sql
